**Company Description** 




 Warp is an open source freight network that connects shippers, carriers, and cross docks into one technology\-powered system for LTL, FTL, box truck, and cargo van freight. The company uses software, AI, pooled capacity, and a network of more than 50 cross docks to optimize the middle mile as well as inbound and last\-mile segments. As shipment volume grows through shared lanes, Warp reduces cost per pallet and passes those savings back to shippers instead of keeping them as margin. Warp currently supports over 1,500 active lanes, more than 20,000 vetted carriers, real\-time visibility, and over 98 percent on\-time delivery nationwide. Shippers can book freight via a dashboard, an API, or directly from an AI agent, reflecting Warp's deep commitment to automation and intelligent systems.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 As an AI Engineer at Warp, you will design, build, and ship AI\-powered products across the freight network \- agentic booking and quoting flows, LLM\-driven pricing and operations assistance, natural\-language interfaces over our APIs, and workflow automation for shippers, carriers, and internal teams. This is hands\-on product engineering with foundation models: you'll work daily with LLM APIs, tool calling, agents, retrieval, and eval pipelines, and integrate them into production systems. You'll monitor quality, latency, and cost in the real world and iterate fast based on user feedback. Beyond building AI features, you'll help make Warp an AI\-native engineering organization \- we expect you to develop software with tools like Claude Code and Cursor as your default workflow, not as an occasional assist. You'll work closely with product, operations, and engineering, and help shape Warp's overall AI strategy. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Los Angeles, CA.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong software engineering foundation: production\-quality code, APIs, data structures, and debugging skills in TypeScript and/or Python.
* Hands\-on experience building with LLMs: prompt design, tool/function calling, agentic workflows, RAG, and structured output using APIs from Anthropic, OpenAI, or similar.
* Daily fluency with AI development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot \- you build software with agents and can demonstrate it.
* Experience shipping LLM features to production: evals, guardrails, monitoring, and managing latency/cost tradeoffs.
* Comfort with the surrounding stack: SQL/NoSQL databases, cloud platforms, and integrating AI services into existing systems.
* Ability to work cross\-functionally and explain AI system behavior and tradeoffs to non\-technical partners.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Nice to have: experience in logistics, transportation, or supply chain technology; MCP or agent\-framework experience.
